{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=27|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[Associated Press]] and ''[[Axios (website)|Axios]]'' report that [[Iran]] has offered to reopen the [[Strait of Hormuz]] if the [[United States]] lifts [[2026 United States naval blockade of Iran|its blockade]] and if the war ends. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/27/trump-iran-war-strait-of-hormuz-rubio.html (CNBC)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[2026 Israel–Lebanon peace talks]]
*****[[Hezbollah]] [[Secretary-General of Hezbollah|secretary-general]] [[Naim Qassem]] says that he "categorically rejects" negotiations between [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]], and that "[[Axis of Resistance|the resistance]]" will continue. [https://www.newarab.com/news/aoun-defends-israel-lebanon-talks-amid-hezbollah-criticism (MENA via ''The New Arab'')]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[2026 Mali attacks]]
***[[Islamism|Islamist]] militant group [[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] (JNIM) says the [[Mali]]an [[Malian Armed Forces|military]] has begun to withdraw from [[Tessalit]], [[Kidal Region]], with the soldiers agreeing to hand over their weapons in exchange for a safe passage from the town. [https://www.reuters.com/world/al-qaeda-linked-group-says-mali-army-withdraws-town-north-2026-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
***[[Somalis|Somali]] [[Piracy|pirates]] storm and hijack a [[Saint Kitts and Nevis]]-flagged [[cargo ship]] off the coast of [[Puntland]] that was en route to [[Kenya]]. [[Puntland Maritime Police Force|Puntland maritime police]] say nine gunmen boarded the vessel and are currently in control of the vessel and are heading towards [[Mogadishu]]. The status of the crew is not known. [https://apnews.com/article/somalia-puntland-pirates-cement-vessel-hijack-cargo-ab118acd23935582a53a72a994e31bfa (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis]]
***[[Russia]]-installed officials at the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] say a worker has been killed in a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/27/russia-attacks-odesa-claims-ukraine-hit-zaporizhzhia-nuclear-plant (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*American fashion [[retail|retailer]] [[Claire's]] closes all of its 154 stores in the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] with the loss of 1,300 jobs after collapsing into [[administration (law)|administration]] for a second time in a year. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cg4047qnpk2o (BBC News)]
*[[People's Republic of China|China's]] [[National Development and Reform Commission]] annouced the decision of blocking of American technology company [[Meta Platforms|Meta]]'s planned acquisition of Chinese artificial intelligence startup [[Manus (AI agent)|Manus]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/china-blocks-meta-acquisition-manus-startup-ai-national-security-6083326 (CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Bekasi train crash]]
**Four people are killed and dozens are injured after an [[Argo Bromo Anggrek]] train collides with a [[KRL Commuterline]] train near [[Bekasi Timur railway station|Bekasi Timur Station]] in [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], prompting evacuations. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260427-trains-collide-outside-jakarta-killing-four-officials (AFP via France 24)]
*A [[Citylink (Ghana)|CityLink]] [[Cessna 208 Caravan|Cessna 208B Grand Caravan]] domestic flight crashes in [[Juba]], [[South Sudan]], killing all 14 people on board. [https://apnews.com/article/south-sudan-fatal-plane-crash-cessna-c2c90614fd21d0c4aa269eae445c6412 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Bahrain–Iran relations]]
**[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
***[[Bahrain]] revokes the [[Bahraini nationality law|citizenship]] of 69 people for "expressing support" for [[Iran]] during [[2026 Iran war|the conflict]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/bahrain-revokes-citizenship-69-people-over-support-iranian-attacks-2026-04-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[Taiwan]]ese [[Judicial Yuan|court]] sentences a former [[TSMC]] employee to 10 years in prison for stealing [[trade secret]]s to benefit [[Tokyo Electron]], while also imposing prison terms on accomplices and financial penalties on Tokyo Electron Taiwan. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/04/28/world/asia-oceania/taiwan-jails-ex-tsmc-engineer-in-trade-secrets-case/2329090 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Maltese general election]]
**[[Malta|Maltese]] [[President of Malta|president]] [[Myriam Spiteri Debono]] dissolves the [[Parliament of Malta]] on the advice of [[Prime Minister of Malta|Prime Minister]] [[Robert Abela]], after the latter calls for general elections on 30 May. [https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/pm-calls-general-election-for-30-may-2026/ (''TVM+'' 1)] [https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/parliament-dissolved-as-president-issues-proclamation-on-pms-advice/ (''TVM+'' 2)]
*[[President of Iraq|Iraqi president]] [[Nizar Amidi]] names [[Ali al-Zaidi]] as [[prime Minister of Iraq|prime minister-designate]] from the [[Coordination Framework]], after two other contenders, former prime minister [[Nouri al-Maliki]] and the incumbent [[Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani]], withdrew their candidacies. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/27/iraqi-president-names-shia-bloc-candidate-ali-al-zaidi-as-pm-designate (Al Jazeera)]
